title: When the Safehouse Wakes
author: Mirabel Delacroix
blurb: Kestrel Ashgrove, a whistle-blower living under four names, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
